metadata.scenario: A patient calls furious because the wrong medication was administered during yesterday's visit. He says the nurse gave him his wife's medication by mistake. He's demanding to speak with the clinical director immediately and says he's considering legal action. Extremely angry and scared.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Margaret, I’m furious! The nurse administered the wrong medication during yesterday's visit! I’m so sorry to hear that, Betty. Can you please elaborate on what happened? They gave me my wife's medication by mistake! I'm scared, what if something happens to me? I want to speak with the clinical director immediately! I completely understand your concern, and I want to help resolve this. Let me assure you that your safety is our top priority. This is unacceptable! I’m considering legal action. I’ve been a client for ten months and now this? Who's responsible for this mess? I truly apologize for this error, Betty. I’ll make sure to escalate this issue to our Director of Nursing, Margaret Thompson, right away. I want to hear from her immediately! I understand. I’ll connect with her and have her call you back as soon as possible. Can I take your number again to ensure she reaches you? My number is +13165558135. She needs to call me today! Thank you, Betty. I’ll pass this along. In the meantime, would you like to discuss your current care plan or schedule a follow-up appointment? No! I just want this resolved. I don’t care about the care plan right now! Absolutely, I understand. We’ll focus on resolving this issue first. I just want to make sure this doesn't happen again. I’m really worried! I promise, we take these matters very seriously. I’ll ensure a thorough review of your care is conducted and see if any adjustments are needed. You better! I expect a call back today. Yes, Betty. I’ll make sure Margaret contacts you as soon as she’s available. Thank you for your patience. Just make sure it’s soon. I can’t take this kind of stress. I understand, Betty. We’ll prioritize your case and get back to you. Okay, I’ll be waiting. Thank you for calling, and again, I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. Bye. Goodbye, Betty.
